name: Afyren Sas
summary: AFYREN SAS provides biobased products to replace petroleum-based molecules in France. The company offers acetic, propionic, butyric and isobutyric, valeric and isovaleric, and caproic acids. Its products are used in the flavors and fragrances, lubricants and functional fluids, feed, food, life sciences, and materials science markets. The company was founded in 2012 and is headquartered in Clermont-Ferrand, France.
